1. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (II a), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein the compound exhibits a specific enolate reactivity profile distinct from potassium enolates__.

2. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl, __wherein R2 is methyl or ethyl and the sodium enolate exhibits enhanced selectivity in carbon-carbon bond formation reactions compared to corresponding potassium enolates__.

3. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is methyl, __wherein the sodium salt of the β-keto methyl ester enolate provides improved regioselectivity in aldol condensation reactions__.

4. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (I Ib) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, __wherein Z is sodium and the compound is the sodium enolate of a β-keto methyl ester__.

5. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 4 of formula (II b) in which Z is sodium, __wherein the sodium enolate exhibits superior nucleophilicity and regioselectivity compared to potassium enolates in carbon-carbon bond forming reactions__.
